en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view across a wide river toward a hilly urban neighborhood. In the foreground a long paddle steamer with a central smokestack sails along the river; the ship's side bears the name "WETTIN." On the opposite bank stands a stone embankment and a bridge entering from the right. Above the river rise several tiers of late‑19th‑century houses and villas, and on the hilltop there are large institutional buildings, possibly schools or administrative complexes, with steep roofs and small towers. The photograph shows some physical damage and abrasions along the lower edge.
